This beta tightens background refresh reliability and makes OpenCode Console estimates safer and more accurate.

## Improvements

- Saving or removing a provider key, or changing its region, source, storage, or usage range, now refreshes the affected provider promptly.
- Provider updates remain limited to two providers at a time across automatic and manual refreshes.

## Fixes

- Refresh requests made while another update is running are now queued instead of being discarded, so enabled providers do not wait for the next scheduled interval.
- OpenCode Console's 5-hour estimate now includes usage from before midnight UTC when the 1-day range is selected.
- OpenCode Console organisation billing estimates no longer trigger Go subscription limit or reset notifications because that source is not authoritative Go quota.
